Top-left front-left neutral stance, top-right back-right neutral stance; bottom-left same front-left subtly lower breathing stance, bottom-right same back-right lower stance. Four complete figures with consistent outfit and native approximately24px height INCLUDING ears and pompom,22px width INCLUDING wings. Enlarge these tiny conceptual pixels uniformly; no fine details smaller than a native pixel.
